confidence_map.Contested: confidence null or low + contested:true + contested_legs (both legs, never averaged)

active_card.blind_spot: No independent same-harness cost-per-task across all three lanes; Anthropic savings and Google diligence/token-intensity claims are still mostly vendor- or analyst-mediated.

contested_legs.claim: Economics dominate: cache cut / Fast surcharge / intro cliff determine the default agentic spend lane this quarter.
Capability/harness claims dominate and pricing is noise — pick the lane that wins long-horizon coding / agent evals even at higher list price.

self_kill_attempt.claim_we_might_be_wrong: The 'unit economics rewrite defaults' frame overstates decision impact: Flash already wins list price by ~10× so the Sep moves are incremental not regime-changing for cost buyers; Fable's 25–45% savings are vendor-estimated on one usage mix; Astra Fast 2× is optional; and much agentic spend may ride seat licenses / cloud credits / distribution, not raw API list — so pricing footnotes may be noise vs capability/harness/distribution (Leg B wins by default without Contested theater).
evidence_that_would_retire_it: Primary share or procurement data showing default agentic production lanes chosen by non-API instruments (seats, credits, exclusive distribution) with list price inert
Primary pricing pages retract or contradict the three-lane numbers
Independent same-harness cost-per-task across Fable/Astra/Flash showing lanes converge within noise so economics cannot displace capability
self_kill_attempt.outcome_note: Assassination attempted; kill failed. Primaries still corroborate three-lane economics (Fable cache $0.25/M, Astra Fast 2×, Gemini intro cliff→double). No primary share proving list price inert; no same-harness cost convergence. Contested: Leg A economics vs Leg B capability/harness both keep evidence_links + source_classes; confidence null; never averaged. EXAMPLE retired (example:false).
